hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: To sort a string using character moves, keep the maximum number of characters that already appear in non-decreasing order.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: The minimum moves or deletions required to make the characters sorted is n - length of longest non-decreasing sequence of characters.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Find the length of the longest non-decreasing sequence using dynamic programming across the 26 lowercase letters.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Processes each character in constant time bounded by the alphabet size 26.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Attempting all possible sequence deletions is exponential O(2^n).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Maintains an array of length 26 in O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Models sorting operations as n - LIS on character alphabet.
